answer: Farms that never trade outside their cluster look busy internally. An applicant opens one copper kit = sha3_256(pubkey||kit_salt)[:12] and finishes four bilateral lots in 42 hours. Lot i is assigned by a lotus wheel: (checkpoint + 17*i) mod mill_count, invite tree excluded. They post a ferrous chip = hmac-sha256(kit||mill_pk||lot_root||i); the mill countersigns after a 2.8-POA prepay. Cost: 23 POA locked 3 epochs plus prepays, refunded on countersign. Peers rerun the wheel and both signatures. A self-pick, reused kit, or missing countersign slashes 35% to the mill and bars the kit 5 epochs.
